'''Kanjon Slyke''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and escape artist active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was caught by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] along with his [[Kanjon Slyke's brother|brother]]. The two were sent to [[Belsavis prison]], where Slyke spent several years, during which his brother died trying to break into the [[Megasecurity Ward 23]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]] he was sprung out of his cell along with three other prisoners - [[Chaney Barrow]], [[Ohta]] and [[Paarkos]]. Their rescuer posed as a fellow inmate, but was in fact [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operative [[Cipher Nine]]. The prisoners released were chosen for their skills and were asked to provide means to break into the [[Megasecurity Ward 23]]. To avoid the attention of [[SCORPIO]] security system, they came up with a plan to reprogram security droids and order them to cause havoc, thus triggering multiple alarms at different locations at once, overloading SCORPIO's capabilities. The plan eventually worked, though SCORPIO managed to disconnect herself from the network and upload her consciousness back into the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] body.<ref name="TOR" />
